import hashlib,json
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd()
out=[]
for name in ("gen_train_concurrency_s15_02_c2_floorplan1","gen_train_concurrency_s15_02_c2_floorplan7"):
    data=json.loads((root/"results"/(name+".json")).read_text()); m=data["metrics"]
    item={"source":name,"search_raw_storage":m.get("search_raw_storage"),"clone_raw_storage_limit":data["config"].get("clone_raw_storage_limit"),"controllers":[]}
    for visit in m.get("controller_visits",[]):
        folder=Path(visit["preflight_reference"]["file"]).parent
        indexes=[]
        for p in sorted(folder.glob("*index*")):
            raw=p.read_bytes()
            indexes.append({"file":str(p),"sha256":hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),"bytes":len(raw)})
        item["controllers"].append({"controller_id":visit["controller_id"],"index_files":indexes,"preflight_exists":(folder/"scene_preflight.json").is_file()})
    out.append(item)
print(json.dumps(out,indent=2,sort_keys=True))
